Shotdesk is a local, single-user short-drama workbench.
Read /AGENTS.md, /api/agent-info, /api/shot-schema and /api/asset-schema before acting.
Current default storyboard: h3-structured-v2. Do not replace it with historical Huobao rules.
Service settings: /api/settings (secrets redacted). Workflows: /api/workflows.
Use stable project/asset/look/version IDs, not array positions or guessed filesystem paths.
